name: Integration for HubSpot CRM – Contact Form 7, WPForms, Elementor, Gravity Forms & More
author: Plugcrux

sections.description:
This plugin allows you to connect HubSpot CRM with all major WordPress contact form plugins. Automatically create contacts, tickets, or deals in HubSpot from form submissions without writing any code.

Supports:
– Contact Form 7
– WPForms
– Elementor Forms
– Gravity Forms
– Formidable Forms

Key benefits:
– Real-time data syncing from forms to HubSpot CRM
– Multi-account support
– Custom field mapping for flexible integrations
– Built-in error logging and retry options

Features

One-Click OAuth Authentication
Securely connect your HubSpot CRM account with a few simple steps. Supports multiple accounts and easy management.

Custom Field Mapping
Map your form fields to HubSpot CRM fields including custom properties for structured and accurate data transfer.

Error Log and Resync
Automatically logs failed submissions with detailed error messages. Retry failed records individually or in bulk.

Multi-Form Integration
Works with the most popular form plugins in a single solution. No need for multiple integrations.

Support

Need help or have a feature request?

  • Contact Support
  • Feature Request

Website: https://integrazo.com/
Email: support@integrazo.com

Additional Notes

This plugin is compatible with WordPress multisite installations. Tested rigorously to ensure reliable and efficient CRM integrations.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation
1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
2. In the search bar, type Integrazo and locate this plugin.
3. Click Install and then Activate.
4. Go to plugin settings to connect your HubSpot CRM account and start syncing.

Manual Installation
1. Upload the plugin ZIP file via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
2. Activate the plugin.
3. Go to plugin settings and complete the setup.
sections.faq:
Which WordPress forms support HubSpot CRM integration?

This plugin offers complete HubSpot CRM integration with major WordPress form plugins. It enables automatic creation of contacts, deals, or tickets in HubSpot from form submissions. Supported form builders include:

  • Contact Form 7 – Connect Contact Form 7 to HubSpot CRM to auto-create CRM records.
  • WPForms – Integrate WPForms with HubSpot CRM for real-time data syncing.
  • Elementor Forms – Send Elementor form submissions to HubSpot CRM automatically.
  • Gravity Forms – Sync Gravity Forms entries with HubSpot CRM using custom field mapping.
  • Formidable Forms – Map Formidable Forms to HubSpot CRM fields for automatic CRM record creation.

How to connect Contact Form 7 to HubSpot CRM? (Contact Form 7 to HubSpot Integration)

To set up Contact Form 7 to HubSpot CRM integration and sync form data automatically:

  • Go to the plugin settings and open the Setup tab.
  • Select Contact Form 7 from the supported form plugins.
  • Choose your connected HubSpot CRM account.
  • Map Contact Form 7 fields (name, email, etc.) to HubSpot CRM fields.
  • Save the integration to enable Contact Form 7 to HubSpot form syncing.

How to integrate WPForms with HubSpot CRM? (WPForms to HubSpot CRM Integration)

To enable WPForms to HubSpot CRM integration and auto-create records:

  • Open plugin settings and go to the Setup tab.
  • Choose WPForms as your form type.
  • Select your HubSpot CRM account.
  • Map WPForms fields (name, phone, message) to HubSpot fields.
  • Save the integration to start WPForms HubSpot form syncing.

How to send Elementor Forms to HubSpot CRM? (Elementor to HubSpot Integration)

Yes, the plugin fully supports Elementor Forms HubSpot CRM integration. Follow these steps:

  • Go to the plugin Setup section.
  • Choose Elementor Forms from the list of supported plugins.
  • Select the HubSpot CRM account for syncing.
  • Map Elementor fields to HubSpot CRM properties.
  • Save and enable Elementor to HubSpot form submission syncing.

Does this plugin support Gravity Forms HubSpot CRM integration? (Gravity Forms to HubSpot CRM Sync)

Absolutely. You can connect Gravity Forms to HubSpot CRM with these steps:

  • Open the plugin settings and navigate to the Setup section.
  • Select Gravity Forms from the plugin list.
  • Choose your connected HubSpot CRM account.
  • Map Gravity Forms fields (like name, email, phone) to HubSpot CRM fields.
  • Save the integration to begin Gravity Forms to HubSpot syncing.

How to connect Formidable Forms with HubSpot CRM? (Formidable Forms HubSpot Integration)

You can sync Formidable Forms with HubSpot CRM to create contacts or deals automatically:

  • Open plugin settings and access the Setup tab.
  • Choose Formidable Forms as the form plugin.
  • Select your HubSpot CRM account.
  • Map Formidable Forms fields to the matching HubSpot CRM fields.
  • Save the setup to start Formidable Forms to HubSpot integration.

Can I map custom fields in HubSpot CRM?

Yes, the plugin supports advanced custom field mapping:

  • You can map any form field—including Contact Form 7, WPForms, or Elementor fields—to HubSpot custom properties.
  • This allows for clean, structured CRM data and advanced automation workflows.

What happens if a form submission fails to sync with HubSpot CRM?

If syncing fails:

  • The failed submission will appear in the Error Logs.
  • You can view detailed HubSpot error messages.
  • Use the Resync button to retry the failed record.
  • Need help? Contact Support.

Is a HubSpot CRM account required for this plugin to work?

Yes. An active HubSpot CRM account is required to connect your WordPress forms and enable syncing.

How secure is the HubSpot CRM integration?

The plugin ensures security and compliance in every connection:

  • OAuth 2.0 for secure API authentication.
  • Encrypted data transfer with HubSpot servers.
  • Follows GDPR-compliant data processing practices.
